outputs.explanation: This is a stacked bar chart showing median state frequencies per Pol II ChIP-seq bin, aggregated across n=5912 promoters. No individual data points (e.g., per-promoter values) are overlaid on the bars.
The single-molecule stack itself displays every individual DNA molecule (2952 molecules) as a row, so individual data points underlying the state-frequency sidebar are directly shown.
Same as panel A but for mouse promoters (n=6122): a stacked bar chart of median state frequencies with no individual data points overlaid.
Single-molecule stack for the mouse Skp1 locus displays each of the 2871 individual molecules, providing the individual data points behind the summarized state frequencies.
Box plot showing PIC occupancy distributions with individual data points (outlier/all points) overlaid as dots on top of the boxes.
Box plot showing Pol II occupancy distributions with individual data points overlaid as dots on top of the boxes.
